title: Church Open Day
description: The Trust will hold an open afternoon for you to explore the church with us, and local historian and genealogist Brittany Warren will lead a tour of the graveyard focusing on some of the mediaeval graves as well as local social history up to the present day.

title: Annual General Meeting (AGM)
description: The Brampton Preservation Trust will hold its Annual General Meeting at Brampton Old Church. All members and interested members of the public are encouraged to attend to discuss the past year's activities and plans for the future.

title: St Ninian's Day Open Evening
description: Join us to celebrate St Ninian's day at Brampton Old Church. Local historian Maks Loth-Hill will present insights and stories about St Ninian and the Old Church in his 6:45 pm talk — Saint Ninian, Brampton, and the World of Early Christianity.

title: Memorial of St Ninian, Bishop (Catholic Mass)
description: To commemorate his ministry and patronage of the chapel in Brampton, Mass will move from Our Lady and St Wilfrid to Brampton Old Church followed by refreshments.
